title: Noise Resilience of Quantum Support Vector Machine with Selected Feature Maps
summary: Gate-level noise degrades the classification accuracy of Quantum Support Vector Machines (QSVMs) on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) hardware, and the degree of degradation depends on how classical data is encoded into quantum states. We tested Z, ZZ, a Pauli, and an amplitude-inspired feature maps under depolarizing, bit-flip, and phase-flip noise channels in $52$ controlled experiments with error probabilities $p =0.01, 0.05, 0.10$, and $0.50$.
